<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>
<Recipe>
  <Description title="Multi-chamber Cu/W bilayer (100A Cu in C1, 150A W in C2)" type="Sputtering" author="LAB" notes="LL -> TM -> C1 (100 A Cu on C1_PSU1 at 250 mA, 50 kHz, 60 percent, 1.250 A/s = 80.00 s) -> C2 (150 A W on C2_PSU at 200 mA, 50 kHz, 60 percent, 0.750 A/s = 200.00 s) -> LL."/>
  <Parameters>
    <Group name="Process Pressures">
      <Param name="PC1" caption="C1 pressure" unit="mTorr" paramType="0">3.00mT</Param>
      <Param name="PC2" caption="C2 pressure" unit="mTorr" paramType="0">2.00mT</Param>
      <Param name="Pbase" caption="Release target" unit="mTorr" paramType="0">0mT</Param>
      <Param name="ArFlow" caption="Ar flow" unit="sccm" paramType="1">40</Param>
    </Group>
    <Group name="Layers">
      <Param name="timeCu" caption="Cu time (100A)" unit="sec" paramType="1">80.00</Param>
      <Param name="timeW" caption="W time (150A)" unit="sec" paramType="1">200.00</Param>
    </Group>
  </Parameters>
  <Script>
# --- transfer wafer from LL into C1 ---
home
valve SV_LL open
valve SV_C1 open
transfer LL C1
valve SV_LL close
valve SV_C1 close

# --- C1 Cu deposition (100 A at 1.250 A/s = 80.00 s) ---
valve C1_V open
mfc C1_Ar ArFlow
pwait PC1 300
set C1_PSU1 Frequency 50
set C1_PSU1 DutyCycle 60
set C1_PSU1 Current 250
power C1_PSU1 on
deposit C1_Cu timeCu
power C1_PSU1 off
set C1_PSU1 Current 0
pwait C1_pm Pbase 10
mfc C1_Ar 0
valve C1_V close
swait C1_pm 0.05mT 120

# --- transfer wafer from C1 into C2 ---
valve SV_C1 open
valve SV_C2 open
transfer C1 C2
valve SV_C1 close
valve SV_C2 close

# --- C2 W deposition (150 A at 0.750 A/s = 200.00 s) ---
valve C2_V open
mfc C2_Ar ArFlow
pwait C2_pm PC2 300
set C2_PSU Frequency 50
set C2_PSU DutyCycle 60
set C2_PSU Current 200
power C2_PSU on
deposit W timeW
power C2_PSU off
set C2_PSU Current 0
pwait C2_pm Pbase 10
mfc C2_Ar 0
valve C2_V close
swait C2_pm 0.05mT 120

# --- return wafer from C2 to LL ---
valve SV_C2 open
valve SV_LL open
transfer C2 LL
valve SV_C2 close
valve SV_LL close
home
  </Script>
</Recipe>

findings.message: 'pwait' takes 3 argument(s) on this machine (sensor target timeout) — the sensor selects which chamber's throttle valve to drive

scriptSummary.pwaitTimeoutsNote: pwait/swait timeout arguments (e.g. 600 s, 10 s) are upper-bound ceilings, not fixed durations; total wall-clock run time cannot be determined without running the recipe.
scriptSummary.commentsNote: All text after '#' or '//' on a line (including ';' characters) is stripped before statement splitting and is completely inert.
